stepTitle: Rebase the repo on a Codex-first operating model and remove hard dependency on claude-code-setup
acceptanceCriteria: No core runtime path or top-level doc still depends on claude-code-setup as the default Claude plugin source, and the repo guidance consistently describes Codex as the primary agent with Claude restricted to UI and verification support.

findings.summary: Referenced claude-support bundle directory does not exist
findings.detail: session_manager.py:148-149 resolves the plugin dir to repo_root/claude-support/look-before-you-leap, and install-claude-bridge-codex-integration.sh:9 sets CLAUDE_SUPPORT_DIR to the same path. Neither path exists on disk. This means _resolve_plugin_dir() will always return None unless CLAUDE_BRIDGE_PLUGIN_DIR is set, silently breaking bridge-launched Claude runs that depend on a plugin dir. The install script prints a warning but does not fail, so a user could complete installation without noticing the missing bundle.

Lines 28, 157, 172, and 177 of look-before-you-leap/skills/look-before-you-leap/references/codex-verify-template.md still direct Claude verification output to ~/Projects/claude-code-setup/usage-errors/codex-findings/. This file was not in the expected-files list but is a direct consumer of the repo identity — it tells Claude where to write findings. After the migration these paths should point at ~/Projects/codex-setup/.

Line 66 uses a glob pattern */.claude/*|*/claude-code-setup/* to exclude paths. This is a Claude-side hook file and may be part of the upstream vendored tree, so its urgency is lower, but it still carries the old repo name.
